Lina (Marketing): Quick ask  We need final creative for the benchmark launch: blog hero (animated), LinkedIn crop, and email header. Can design confirm sizes + preferred export names? Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ABCD/pulse-brief
Omar (Design): Sure. Propose master 1400x560 in Figma. Exports: blog_gif_1400x560.gif, linkedin_1200x627.gif, email_600x200.gif + fallback email.png. Will keep loop short and no flashing text.
Bea (DesignOps): To hit file-size goals I'll run palette reduction and frame-dropping. My CLI snippet: `gifsicle --optimize=3 --colors 64 --lossy=80 source.gif > out.gif`. Target sizes: blog <800KB, linkedin <450KB, email <180KB.
Cory (Content): Caption copy suggestion: "Pulse benchmark: latency and cost compared across models." Alt: "Animated chart showing latency vs per-token cost for Redwood Inference."
A11y (QA): Add: provide transcript for any on-screen copy in post meta; add alt and caption; avoid >3 flashes/sec. I'll review once drafts are in Figma.
Omar (Design): I'll upload draft frames tonight and final exports by Tuesday noon. Tagging Lina when done.
Bea (DesignOps): I'll push optimized assets to s3://redwood-marketing/launch-assets/pulse/ and paste links here when ready.
Lina (Marketing): Deadline: need assets in S3 by Tue 5pm to stage blog and schedule posts. Thanks team! :rocket:
